name: Touch of Weakness
label: Quest
description: Touch of Weakness: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You be far from home, adventurer. You be needed there, back in your city under the ground. Your mistress, the one you be callin' Aelthalyste be needin' you back there. Like my tribe, there things you must learn only from her. Don't be stayin' here too long. You should be headin' to the War Quarter as fast as a zeppelin can carry you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, good, another has arrived. Time may not matter to me, but to you it is of the essence. There is much for you to learn and there is much I wish to teach you. You simply must prove your worth. Do that, and you shall be greatly rewarded.
